notes.title: X Invader v1.0.0 Full Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, Invaders!
This is Allaf Games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/85c22b5da860480145da52b84af575f21963e8e8.png

We are thrilled to announce that the X Invader 1.0.0 official version has finally been released!

Thanks to the valuable feedback from all of you during the Early Access period, we were able to refine and enhance X Invader into an even more polished game.

We truly believe that your interest and support have brought us to this point, and we want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who played our game.

For those who participated in the beta test, your data will carry over to the official version.

If you'd like to replay the new content added in the official release, you can reset the new content by pressing the 'Stage 3 Reset' button on the title screen and enjoy it from the beginning.

Additionally, while we initially considered a price increase after the official release, we have decided to keep the price unchanged to ensure that more players can enjoy our game without any added burden.


We hope you continue to show your interest in X Invader, 
and once again, we sincerely thank all of our players.

Thank you!


[ Full Release Update ]

New Stage

 Stage 3 "Allaf Company" has been added.
 Four new bosses have been introduced.


Story Conclusion

 The complete story of X Invader is now revealed.


New Content

 New achievements have been added.
 One new Oppart has been introduced.


Other Changes

  Avatar "Ninja X" and "Cheese Mouse" effects modified
- Added: Attack Speed +15%
 Avatar "Bunny" effect modified
- Added: +1 Dash count
 CPU Breaker upgrade "Thorn Bullet Specialization" effect modified
- (Old) All bullets are converted to Thorn Bullets.
    → (New) Thorn Bullets are enhanced.
 CPU Breaker upgrade "Elemental Bullet Specialization" effect modified
- (Old) All bullets are converted to Elemental Bullets.
    → (New) Elemental Bullets are enhanced.
 Oppart "Loki's Hat" effect modified
- (Old) Randomly boosts two of Physical, Elemental, or Summon Damage by +25%, while reducing the remaining one by -50%.
    →  (New) Every 50 enemies defeated with the Basic Spell further enhances the Basic Spell, with the 
          required number of defeats doubling each time.



https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090760/

※ A 30% discount event is also being held to celebrate the official release.

notes.title: v0.9.0 Update Notice
notes.notes:
Hello, Invaders!

We would like to inform you about today's hotfix. 
For detailed information, please refer to the [Hotfix Details] below!

■ Update Version: v 0.9.0

■ Hotfix Details:

1. New Weapon

 A new weapon, 'CPU Breaker,' has been added to the Dodo Shop.

2. Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the game would freeze upon clearing security level 8 in Spark in the Street.
 Fixed an issue where the Kunoichi avatar would not unlock even after meeting the conditions.
 Fixed an issue where sound effect volume could not be adjusted in certain situations.

3. Balance

 The effect of Commander Badger's add-on 'High-Performance Virus' has been adjusted.
- (Before) The virus spreads to other enemies.
- (After) The virus has a 50% chance to spread to other enemies.
 The damage over time application rate for Shige-Kun's add-ons 'Doom Bomb' and 'Calamity Bomb' has been adjusted.
- (Before) Applies damage over time every 1 second
- (After) Applies damage over time every 0.5 seconds
 The size of Shige-Kun's add-on bombs has been increased.
 Shige-Kun's bomb now explodes immediately upon hitting the ground.
 The effects of Shige-Kun's add-ons 'Hero’s Skill', 'Princess’ Wisdom', 'Chasing Calamity', and 'Intended Doom' have been adjusted.
- (Before) The bomb explodes immediately when it hits the ground.
- (After) The bomb now tracks enemies.
 The effect of Ooparts 'Infinity Bandana' has been adjusted.
- (Before) +3 Max Magazine 
- (After) +30 Max Magazine, +10% Attack Speed
 The effect of Ooparts 'Gemstone Predator' has been adjusted.
- (Before) Devours all the Spell Gems you have. Grants +20% to All Damage per 1 Spell Gem. 
- (After) Every time you use a Spell, you permanently gain +1 Max HP and +1 Max Magazine.
 The attack speed reduction effect of Ooparts 'Furious Rush' has been removed.
 The effect of Code Cutter enhancement add-on 'Blade Storm' has been adjusted.
- (Before) Blade Storm occurs on attack.
- (After) Blade Storm occurs on Last Shot activation.
 The effect of the synergy add-on 'Virus of Doom' has been adjusted.
 The penalty effect of Ooparts 'Diamond Pickaxe' has been removed.
 The coin acquisition rate for Shige-Kun's add-on 'Sub Quest' has been increased.
 Adjustments have been made to facilitate the use of 'Graviton Bullet' in the physical build of the E-Laser add-on.
- Modified the level 4 upgrade of the 'Heavy Laser Cannon' add-on (Condensed Photon Bomb → Graviton Bullet)
- Changed the ultimate add-on for the physical build (Graviton Bullet → Condensed Photon Bomb)
 The effect of the DDOS Gauntlet add-on 'High Efficiency Magazine' has been adjusted.
- (Before) Has a 33% chance of not consuming ammo when attacking while not moving.
- (After) Has a 33% chance of not consuming ammo.
 The effect of the DDOS Gauntlet add-on 'Plasma Blast' has been adjusted.
- (Before) +1 Ammo Consumed per Attack, Each shot is considered 2 attacks.
- (After) Number of Plasma Bullets +1
 The effect of the DDOS Gauntlet add-on 'Efficient Hunting' has been adjusted.
- (Before) Periodically summons an Alpha Wolf Spirit.
- (After) +25% Wolf Spririt's Cooldown Acceleration

4. Improvements

 When entering the game with a Soul Code equipped, you will start with the level 1 add-on of the equipped Soul Code.


■ Additional Information:

 If you experience issues with gameplay after the update, please first conduct a file integrity check.
 Guide to Conducting a File Integrity Check


▶X Invader Discord
If you encounter any issues during gameplay, 
please report them on our Discord for prompt assistance.


We thank all players for playing X Invader.
Enjoy your gameplay!

notes.title: Official Release Schedule Postponement Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Allaf Games.

We would like to inform you that the official release date of X Invader has been postponed to August. We sincerely apologize for not being able to keep our promise to our users and for having to convey this message.

The reason for the delay in the official release schedule is as follows.


1. Improvement of Previously Released Content
Since the early access launch, we have received a lot of valuable feedback from many users. What we realized from this feedback was that our development team lacked sufficient refinement of the existing content. We reflect on this and intend to improve the content that was previously released, based on the feedback we have received so far. Our development team's intention is to avoid repeating the mistakes of a premature release like we had at the early access launch.
    
2. Overhaul of UI/UX and Scenario Improvement Work/b]
The UI/UX and scenario team members joined in the middle of the development, which led to a somewhat rushed approach to their work. The team members who joined later have now fully understood our internal systems and are continuously working on improving their respective areas of responsibility.

3. Conducting Adequate Beta Testing
When we released the early access version of X Invader, we launched without conducting an open beta test, which led to numerous unexpected bugs. This has caused us to deeply reflect, as it provided a less than ideal playing experience for our players. For the official release, we want to conduct sufficient beta testing to present a high-quality product that meets the expectations of the players who have trusted and supported X Invader.

4. Financial Issues
Currently, Allaf Games is facing financial difficulties, a chronic problem for many indie game teams. Therefore, in order to sustain Allaf Games, we find ourselves in a situation where the development of X Invader and subsequent projects need to be carried out concurrently (attracting investment, publishing deals).

Of course, the fact that X Invader will be officially released remains unchanged. However, due to the need to secure funding, tasks have to be diversified, leading us to decide to extend the development period for the sake of the game's quality. We deeply apologize for the extension of the official release date due to our development team's financial situation.



We truly apologize for having to convey this message, as we understand how precious each and every expectation and support from the players waiting for X Invader is. For those players who are waiting, we plan to continue with regular updates.

Additionally, our development team will always strive to communicate effectively with our users. We will sincerely respond to any comments left on platforms such as Discord and the Steam discussion board.

Once again, we apologize and assure you that Allaf Games will always listen attentively to the players' opinions.

Thank you.

notes.title: X invader - Early Access release on August 23th!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340961/aa38c0a431fa4c76d7c1bb536cc4cf0903785b90.png

Hello! This is Allaf Games :)

The Early Access of "X Invader" will release at 7PM on August 23th (PDT).

First and foremost, we would like to express our gratitude to the players who have shown continuous interest and support for "X Invader" since its demo version release.

Starting with the unveiling of Early Access, we will accept feedback and suggestions to further develop "X Invader" into an even better game.


[ Features of Early Access ]

1. New Stage: Spark in the Street 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/ca128420e8467fbec30f90329251e38470076722.png
The "Spark in the Street" stage will be added. It's a robotics company known for its outstanding products in various fields including medical, education, and military. Infiltrate the servers of "Spark in the Street" and uncover their secrets!


2. Soul Code
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/e5a7697c20a0f63ae050ecb0366cd6d194372e85.png
The battle data you've accumulated has given rise to a new power! This ability, known as the Soul Code, enhances your existing addons. Utilize the Soul Code to sweep away your enemies even faster!


3. Company-specific Final Bosses
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/56e075a322b9ad93806d69dcfde849ff8ddf8fb1.png
Extremely powerful final bosses will appear. They are the confidential data of each company. 
They won't be easy to take down!

4. Security Level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/add2330746b473d4fcc963e989f2cca8b590dccd.png
Clearing stages increases the security level, and the enemies become progressively stronger. 
Overcome the heightened security to take over the servers of these corporations.

5. Addition of 2 New Weapons
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/e02546666d0fc760e577366d3f0198e4efb1866e.png
Rinascita's tool hacker, Dodo, has developed new hacking gear! A more diverse playstyle has become possible.

1) Vaccine Crasher
Fires missiles that deliver a circular area attack. Utilize these rapidly exploding missiles to wipe out security codes (monsters) in an instant.

2) E-Laser
Emits a laser that targets and focuses on an enemy. The E-Laser deletes security codes (monsters) in a split second with its condensed power.


6. New Comrades
Rinascita's comrade hacker Shige-kun and EmperorBoxeR have decided to offer additional support.
Also, Rinascita leader GM and apprentice hacker Miyaong have returned to Rinascita!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/d7f6c51f5b484dd290e06ae5b9ac230a06ccbde5.png

1) Shige-kun (provides remote bomb addons)
With bombs filling the sky, he began hacking the world in search of a princess he believes exists somewhere.

2) Emperor BoxeR (supports drone addons)
She is both an individual and an army. She's a streamer with ten million followers, known for her hacking broadcasts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42708440/c084994dc4d3fce6c6968b75abc5e4f1e53425ff.png

3) Miyaong
A lobby NPC responsible for cuteness.
She's studying hard to become a formal hacker.

4) GM
Leader of Rinascita, a lobby NPC who runs a bar in the hideout.

7. Supported Languages
English, Chinese (Simplified), Korean, Japanese, and Portuguese.


8. And many more..
- UI/UX improvements
- Controller operation improvements
- Addition of 5 new avatars
- Story additions


Additionally, there's a 10% early access launch discount, and a bundle discount with the fast-paced roguelite bullet heaven game 'Spellbook Demonslayers' is also planned.


Look forward to an even more exciting "X Invader"!

See you on August 23th ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090760/_/
